stem.en: A ship's sonar pulse gets an echo after 2.0 s, so the depth is 1500 m. Then the ship sends a pulse with four times the frequency into the same seawater. The echo again comes back after 2.0 s. What is the depth now?

text.en: Still 1500 m, because in one medium all frequencies travel at the same speed.
375 m, because a higher frequency travels four times slower.
6000 m, because a higher frequency travels four times faster.
It cannot be found, because the frequency has changed.

explanation.en: In one medium, all frequencies travel at the same speed. The echo time is the same, so the depth is the same: 1500 m.

hints.en: Does the speed of sound in seawater depend on the frequency?
